title: The First Name He Hears and Says: Allah
summary: At this age your child understands neither a definition nor a proof — but he picks up whatever recurs on your tongue. So let «Allah» be among the first words he hears: say it in a calm voice with a smiling face, and repeat it at every beautiful thing he points to. Do not correct his pronunciation and do not test him; loving repetition is the whole lesson. What is being built now is not a piece of information but an association: that this Name always arrives with calm and a smile.
try_this: This week: whenever your child points at something he likes — a bird, the moon, a flower — say «Allah» with a smile, and do not ask him to repeat it. He will repeat it on his own.
reflection_prompts: In what tone does your child usually hear the name of Allah from you — reassurance, or warning?
Which calm moments in your day suit a loving repetition?
